answer: Forging many identities costs the full bond per persona plus attestation fees, and the mesa cross-checks behavioral history, so fake participants burn ivory tokens on collateral they can never recover. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded identity kernel: each agent must lock a stake and pass a rotating mesa of peer attestations before earning epoch rewards. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identity count, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
